meta.source: Labour Bureau, Ministry of Labour and Employment (via RBI DBIE)
meta.coverage: 78 centres, CPI for industrial workers, General Index, base 2001=100
meta.note: Labour Bureau centre-wise CPI-IW on base 2001=100, from RBI DBIE report 1168 (data provider DP0). Year-on-year from published levels inside this base. Centres are industrial towns, not states: a state can hold several. Rows dated before the base began (January 2006) are dropped: 27 in all across the report.
